name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A popup that appears when an element is hovered or focused, showing a hint for sighted users.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  interface Props extends Tooltip.ContentProps {
    children?: Snippet;
    showArrow?: boolean;
    sideOffset?: number;
  }

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    showArrow = false,
    children,
    sideOffset = 4,
    side = 'top',
    ...restProps
  }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Tooltip.Portal>
  <Tooltip.Content
    {ref}
    {side}
    {sideOffset}
    class={cn(
      'bg-popover text-popover-foreground animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 relative z-50 max-w-70 rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-xs',
      className
    )}
    {...restProps}
  >
    {@render children?.()}
    {#if showArrow}
      <Tooltip.Arrow class="text-popover -my-px drop-shadow-[0_1px_0_hsl(var(--border))]" />
    {/if}
  </Tooltip.Content>
</Tooltip.Portal>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';

  interface Props extends Omit<Tooltip.ProviderProps, 'delayDuration'> {
    children?: Snippet;
    delay?: number;
  }

  let { delay, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Tooltip.Provider delayDuration={delay} {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip } from 'bits-ui';

  interface Props extends Omit<Tooltip.RootProps, 'delayDuration'> {
    delay?: number;
  }

  let {
    delay,
    open = $bindable(false),
    triggerId = $bindable(null),
    ...restProps
  }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Tooltip.Root bind:open bind:triggerId delayDuration={delay} {...restProps} />
